name: smoke-mixed-desk
description: Mixed desk smoke app: a native What shell (router, layout, signals store) hosting React components from real npm libraries, with data flowing both ways under load, and a server-rendered page whose React island hydrates.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.ssr.config.js && vite build -c vite.ssr.config.js --ssr src/ssr/entry-server.jsx --outDir dist/server
